purpose: Dated legal-entity rights and cadastral lineage for the Grands-Échezeaux research register. Evidence of recorded rights and parcel splits only; never of farming.
rules: A recorded right is legal-entity ownership or another real right on 1 January, never farming.
Private individuals are not in the legal-entity files: no record does not mean no owner.
Holder continuity is proved only by the same SIREN; names alone are hints for review.

Lineage is accepted only when a successor first appears in the next vintage and lies at least 95% inside the retired reference; other overlaps are rejected candidates. It is rule-based, not a documented division act.
